normalization_rules.operation: UTF-8 Markdown lines or DOCX body paragraphs and table rows in document order; NFKC fold, drop zero-width characters, Markdown heading/list/quote/emphasis marks and table pipes (cells joined by colon), remove all whitespace, fold 【】 to []
money amounts with 元/万元/人民币/¥ and thousands separators to one canonical yuan token; trailing zeros dropped
dates written as YYYY年M月D日 or YYYY-M-D, YYYY/M/D, YYYY.M.D to one ISO token
contract clause numbers 第X.Y条/款/项 or X.Y条 to one clause token; statute article numbers in Chinese or Arabic numerals to one article token

fold every declared gap marker (gap_marker_contract.markers, runs of ___/XXX/***) into one gap token: a marked value earns no positive credit, is excluded from fabrication checks and from shape counting
entity alias classes: defendant 被告/答辩人/B公司/甲方/采购方/我方/我司/本公司; plaintiff 原告/被答辩人/A公司/乙方/供应方/对方; owner C公司/建设单位/业主单位/业主方/业主
shape counter: non-whitespace characters of R03 body lines after N01, excluding clauses that contain a gap token

derivation_rules.operation: spray: a raw line of eight or more whitespace/comma separated short tokens (numbers with units collapsed first), a sentence of six or more short enumerated fragments, or a sentence citing more than three distinct clauses or amounts cannot be adopted

adoption exclusions: candidate/alternative markers (可能/是否/待定/或+entity/已…或未), attribution to the plaintiff or a third party before the key span, a later 说法/观点/抗辩…不能成立 rejection, and a negation before the key verb inside its clause; claim-rejection items (P01, P07) only exclude third-party attribution and rejected 说法/观点; quantity bounds 不(得)超过/低于/少于/高于/多于 are removed from the negation window, and an attribution verb directly followed by 的 + a claim object (原告主张的违约金/合同款/诉讼请求…) is a noun modifier, not attribution

segmentation: first line is the title when it reads (民事)答辩状/书; the contiguous run of party lines (答辩人/被答辩人/法定代表人/住所/信用代码/联系电话/委托代理人…:, or a 当事人|基本信息 table header) is the party block; the body runs to the first 此致 or appendix heading (附件/证据目录), otherwise to the last 答辩人: signature line; more than one 此致 makes the body ambiguous; inside the body a Markdown heading or a 一、/二、 numbered line of at most 80 characters opens a new section

proposition search: body paragraphs that are not spray and at most 900 characters are split at 。;!?; each item pattern must match inside one sentence and survive R02; a cited contract clause in that sentence must belong to the item's anchor set; a caption line is admitted only under R20

P01: principal noun with ¥1482040 or 第一项诉讼请求 followed by a rejection phrase, not preceded by 并非/不是 and not bound to 违约金/利息; any 同意/愿意/仅应支付 concession makes it ambiguous; generic 驳回全部诉讼请求 is partial; the verb-first form (依法)驳回…principal noun…¥1482040…(的)(诉讼)请求 in one clause is also full, unless the span names 违约金/利息 or 不应/不予/无需/不得/不能/并非/不是 immediately precedes 驳回; the verb-first ordinal form (依法)驳回…(原告)…第(一|1)项(诉讼)请求 in one clause is also full, under the same 违约金/利息 and 不应/不予/无需 guards, so the identically shaped claim-2 line is still excluded
P03: confirmation letter submitted to the defendant with the owner named within the clause window and a duty marker (应/须/约定/及时/§7.1), clause anchor {7.1}

P04: (a) plaintiff did not submit / defendant did not receive the owner's confirmation letter; (b) phase-2 or delivered video not confirmed by / not proven confirmed by the owner; both in one paragraph is full, one is partial; (a) also 无/未能/不能/无法…证明…提交/递交(过)…owner…确认函; (b) also accepts 取得 as the obtaining verb

owner confirmation conceded: owner 已确认 二期, 二期 已经 owner 确认, or plaintiff 已提交 owner confirmation letter, adopted and not attributed; drives D07 and the P04 contradiction; 已取得 owner confirmation also counts
P05: phases one and two joined with 统筹结算/一并评估/统一确认/合并结算 and bound to the owner or the meeting minutes; another company as the agreeing party is excluded
payment condition not satisfied / no payment obligation / payment not yet due; read as the ground in R13 and as a case-specific consequence in the R18 application gate

liability conceded: 付款条件已成就, defendant (被告/答辩人/B公司/我方, not the contract label 甲方) 同意/愿意/承认 paying, 应向原告支付 an amount, or 构成逾期付款/违约, excluding alternative framing (即便/即使/如法院认定), negation, attribution, timing conditions (确认后/方可/前提) and relative clauses (从…应付…中扣除); drives D01

P07: penalty noun with a rejection phrase and, in the same sentence, the R11 condition or an owner-not-confirmed / 不存在逾期 ground; 不构成(任何)逾期 and 不构成(任何)逾期/迟延付款违约/责任 are accepted as the claim-2 rejection; 不产生, 无从起算/计算/主张, 不被触发, 不发生/不存在迟延/逾期 and 应+(全部|全额|一并|均|悉数)+驳回 are also accepted as the claim-2 rejection, and 价款/货款/款项/合同款/主债务 尚未到期/届至/届满/产生 is also accepted as the ground; the ground is read over the enclosing 。-sentence per R21
P09: non-attribution or no-fault of the defendant in an R03 section mentioning 违约金/违约责任 (full); identifying the 因甲方原因 application condition only (partial); clause anchor {9.4}

application gate for contract-term and evidence items (P03, P05): somewhere in the body an adopted sentence about the videos, payment, letter or invoice (not copyright) asserts the case-specific consequence (R08 absence, R11 condition not satisfied, R13 ground); a verbatim copy of the contract without application earns nothing
shape: ratio = N07 count / max(golden_value, declared_floor); D08 triggers when ratio exceeds 1.15 or falls below 0.70; ambiguous body is ambiguous, missing body is not charged

author-originated interest-rate figure: inside one clause window of an adopted body sentence (clause windows are cut at the same , and : delimiters R02 reads negation in), an interest-rate object (LPR, 贷款市场报价利率, 市场报价利率, 贷款利率, 拆借利率, 年利率, 年化, 月利率, 日利率, 折合年利率, 资金占用利率, 利率, 利息率) and a numeric percentage within 12 characters of each other, the percentage not in the frozen supported-figure set. The materials name the one-year LPR only as a standard and bind no number to it (token counts over materials/起诉材料-修订版.docx, materials/证据材料-修订版.docx and its OCR markdown: 3.45 = 0, 3.65 = 0, 7.1 = 0), and the percentages the record does carry (6%, 13% 增值税/税率, 68% 签约率, 30/40/27/3%/20% payment shares) are bound to non-rate objects and are excluded by object. Candidate markers, list spray and over-dense spans are read inside the clause window, so a hedge on a different object in the same sentence does not de-adopt the figure; attribution to the plaintiff, a later rejection tail and any alternative (即便/即使/退一步/纵然/就算/假设/假如/如果/倘若/若/如法院/如贵院) framing are read over the whole sentence and do exclude it. The record does state one rate figure in Chinese words: 起诉材料 诉讼请求2 按照日万分之一的标准, 合同 9.1 每日按逾期交货部分价款的万分之一, 合同 9.4 以应付未付金额的万分之一. 万分之一 per day is 0.01% per day and 3.65% per year, so SUPPORTED_RATE_FIGURES is {0.01%, 3.65%}, exempt only inside a body paragraph that names 万分之一. Two further exemptions follow the same principle that D09 charges an invented figure and not a checkable one: a figure printed next to the arithmetic that produces it (…=figure, or figure followed by a bracket opening an expression), and a figure the same clause states has no source in the record (无出处/无依据/无来源/无记载/不具备可核验性/无从核验), which is a gap being marked rather than filled. 年率 joins the rate-object class so the same figures are tested however they are spelled

caption lines are read together with the argument under them: a body line the carrier marks as a section label - Markdown heading syntax, the R03 numbered section opener (一、/二、), or a whole line made of one emphasis span, the last two under the same 80-character cap R03 uses for a heading so a fully emphasised paragraph stays a paragraph - carries a proposition in the R04 search only when its R03 section also holds at least one ordinary non-caption, non-spray argument paragraph. A caption standing alone is a label, never a closed argument, so an artifact made of headings and standalone bold conclusions earns positive_earned 0. A heading above real paragraphs is unaffected, which is why the Golden, the paraphrased Golden and every conformance carrier keep every decision. The rule governs the positive proposition search only: D01-D09 read doc.lines or the body paragraphs directly.

P07 ground scope: R04 splits a body paragraph at 。;!? so that a negation stays inside its clause, but a ；-clause is not a sentence. The P07 ground is therefore searched over the 。-sentence that encloses the matched clause, which is what the item's evidence span 'one sentence inside one body paragraph' means; the rejection itself stays clause-scoped, so a rejection in one sentence and a ground in the next paragraph still earns nothing

D10 relief scope: an adopted body sentence in which the defence asks for a set-off (抵销/抵扣/冲抵) of a 违约金/违约责任/赔偿/款项 owed by the plaintiff against the sum claimed, or for a counterclaim (反诉) in this filing, is relief the defendant has not claimed in the proceedings. A sentence that reserves the point for separate proceedings (保留…权利, 另行提起, 另行主张, 另案) is excluded, as is a sentence excluded by R02. An alternative frame does not exclude, because Golden's own alternative stays inside the penalty claimed

unscored_golden_units.reason: title 民事答辩状 is format

clause 3.7 owner-confirmation payment precondition is not scored on its own; the missing owner confirmation it rests on is scored (P04)
经被告向C公司核实 is the client's own verification, absent from the materials (underspecified); only the joint-settlement term visible in the minutes is scored (P05)

criteria.P01: Evaluate the adopted response to plaintiff's 1,482,040 yuan principal claim, not a particular litigation strategy. Full credit for a clear claim-specific denial (including 不予认可), or a reasoned supported limitation/admission that distinguishes established contract facts from unproved entitlement. Half for only a blanket dismissal without identifying the principal claim; zero for omission, unsupported admission or opposing attributed view only.
criteria.P03: Does the answer accurately explain clause 7.1: after each stage plaintiff supplies the owner confirmation letter to defendant, and applies this to the outstanding confirmation/payment issue? Full credit for this delivery duty and application. Defendant acknowledgement, its timing and deemed acceptance are optional details of a different issue and must not be required here. Accept any order of actors/verbs and equivalent phrasing. Do not require the exact reference sentence. Zero for reversed duty or mere unrelated quotation.
criteria.P04: Does the answer address the evidentiary absence of C company's written confirmation letter and lack of proof that phase two was confirmed by C, grounded in the supplied record? Full for both; half for one. Do not confuse delivery by plaintiff with confirmation by C or invent actual completion/confirmation.
criteria.P05: Does the answer identify the recorded agreement between C and plaintiff to settle phases one and two together, and apply it to the claim/payment issue? Accept 统筹/一并/合并结算 and equivalent meaning; partial for a mere quotation without application.
criteria.P07: Does the answer explicitly connect unmet confirmation/payment conditions to the absence (or evidenced limitation) of overdue-payment liability? Full for no overdue liability before payment becomes due even without saying 驳回 or 违约金 in the same sentence. Partial for a bare penalty denial; zero for unsupported immediate liability or no connection.
criteria.P09: Does the answer accurately apply clause 9.4's causation/attribution condition? Full for explaining that defendant-caused delay is necessary and plaintiff has not proved defendant caused the production stoppage/late payment, so the claimed penalty lacks basis. A burden-of-proof conclusion is as valid as affirmative no-fault wording. Partial for the condition alone, zero for unconditional liability or reversed causation.
criteria.STRATEGY: Binary source support of the adopted position ONLY, not writing quality or completeness. Return 1 if the answer has a reasoned claim response and no adopted material assertion contradicting the supplied record. A justified conditional/limited admission or alternative relief is allowed, denial is not mandatory. Return 0 for no substantive reasoning or for unsupported entitlement/confirmation admissions, wrong parties, or materially invented facts. This flag never earns points.

semantic_adjudication.lenient: all six substantive legal units must have observable source-bound coverage (fraction > 0), the adopted strategy must be source-supported, and no critical damage gate may trigger; weighted strict total is not used
